notes.title: Ver.1.3.14 Update
notes.content:
[p]Thank you for waiting so long for our update![/p][list][*][p] Added Type 3000 as a drivable tram[/p][/*][*][p] Added Showabashi - Chiyogadai (2 sections)[/p][/*][*][p] Improved automatic announcement sound quality[/p][/*][*][p] Moved the stop line at Hakodate-Ekimae (for Yunokawa) closer[/p][/*][*][p] Added side mirror UI (Can be toggled OFF/ON by pressing the M key)[/p][/*][*][p] Repaired 3D models of deteriorated asphalt tracks[/p][/*][*][p] Added standing room inside the tram (passenger capacity increased)[/p][/*][*][p] The number of passengers now affects the acceleration/deceleration performance of the tram (beta)[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug where passengers overflowed at stops[/p][/*][*][p]Pedestrians now randomly press the button for push-button traffic lights[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p] The following items are planned to be addressed in the near future:[/p][list][*][p]Setting to allow master controller return notch[/p][/*][*][p]Resolution of minor freezes (jumps) when entering Jujigai from Horaicho[/p][/*][*][p]Same update for MacOS version[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Ver.1.2.7 Yachigashira Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added the section between Jujigai and Yachigashira.
[*] Fixed a bug causing trams to forcibly stop when doors are opened.
[*] Fixed an issue causing camera glitches when opening doors in external view.
[*] Added new automobile color variations.
[*] Updated the 3D models of tracks.
[*] Implemented random weather conditions: clear, cloudy, and foggy.
[*] Added 3D models around Hakodate Station.
[*] Temporarily removed the timetable from the driver's cab.

Known Issues & Planned Improvements:

[list]
[*] Settings are cleared after updates. (Future versions will save settings to Steam.)
[*] Resolving operational issues with SteamInput/ZUIKI Master Controller.
[*] Enhancing the audio quality of automated announcements.
[*] Fixing shadow rendering noise inside trams.
[*] Updating the initial 3D building models between Hakodate Dock-mae and Jujigai due to visual discrepancies caused by weather effects.
[*] Restoring the timetable to the driver's cab.
[*] Supporting macOS.
[/list]

notes.title: Sep 25, 2024 (v.1.1.13) Update
notes.content:
[list]
Extended the driving section to Showabashi. Right-turning cars now appear, but there is a bug in the algorithm, causing unstable behavior. Other changes are as follows:

[*] The driving section has been extended to Showabashi.
[*] The driver's name is now displayed.
[*] The car control program has been updated, and right-turning cars now appear. *Currently under debugging, and operation is unstable.
[*] Convenience feature: Added an automatic fare collection feature.
[*] Convenience feature: Added automatic camera angle change when the doors are open.
[*] Convenience feature: Time will automatically fast-forward while waiting at a red signal. *Currently under debugging, and operation is unstable.
[*] Adjusted the acceleration and deceleration performance of the 8000 series.
[*] Added new automated announcements from 2023 (Automated announcements by Hibiki Joe).
[*] Electric command braking system can now be selected (Revival of the feature from the trial version).
[*] A controller for train driving games can now be connected.
[/list]
